work: Council Item #1: Quantitative CFTR plasma-membrane expression benchmark evaluating whether untreated baseline expression (log2 DMSO Mut/WT), CFTR sub-domain, and variant class predict VX-661+VX-445 rescue (log2 Mut/WT) on a residue-clustered, PRED-0010-disjoint held-out slice of Tedman et al. 2025 (CC BY 4.0).

claims.statement: Cross-study positive control on AGM ALT Library Comparison.xlsx (N = 103 shared CFTR variants between McKee et al. 2023 and Tedman et al. 2025) reproduces Pearson r = 0.998856 (linear) and Spearman rho = 0.965767.
claims.dataset: sources/downloads/tedman-2025/AGM ALT Library Comparison.xlsx (CC BY 4.0, DOI 10.17632/ksfmxv8zts.1) summarized in benchmarks/cftr_dms_expression/results_2026-11-23.json

methods.name: IEEE-754 float Pearson r in benchmark parser
methods.difference: parses XLSX XML Sheet1 with float64 and computes Pearson r in float arithmetic

methods.name: Decimal exact-parse cross-study audit
methods.difference: separate XLSX XML reader computing covariances via decimal.Decimal without importing cftr_dms_benchmark.py

claims.statement: On 67 held-out CFTR variants across 59 unexposed codons (zero overlap with dev or PRED-0010), untreated-expression OLS (log2 VX-661+VX-445 ~ log2 DMSO fitted on 167 dev variants) achieves held-out MAE = 0.451487 log2(Mut/WT) vs constant dev-median MAE = 1.077948.
claims.dataset: sources/downloads/tedman-2025/ALT 9-6-24 CFTR DMS Expanded Library Master Tables.xlsx (sheet All_variants, CC BY 4.0) summarized in benchmarks/cftr_dms_expression/results_2026-11-23.json

methods.name: Simple 1D OLS normal equations estimator
methods.difference: direct centered covariance 1D OLS fit on 167 dev rows evaluated on 67 holdout rows

methods.name: Cholesky 2x2 independent re-derivation
methods.difference: separate XML reader fitting 2x2 normal equations via Cholesky L L^T factorization

claims.statement: On the same 67 held-out variants (59 unexposed codons), partial-penalized Ridge (unpenalized intercept + log2 DMSO slope plus dev-standardized CFTR sub-domain and variant-class indicators with alpha=100.0 chosen by 5-fold residue-clustered dev CV) achieves held-out MAE = 0.434782 log2(Mut/WT).
claims.dataset: sources/downloads/tedman-2025/ALT 9-6-24 CFTR DMS Expanded Library Master Tables.xlsx (sheet All_variants, CC BY 4.0) summarized in benchmarks/cftr_dms_expression/results_2026-11-23.json

methods.name: Partial-pivoting Gaussian elimination solver
methods.difference: solves 10x10 partial-penalized normal equations by Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting

methods.name: Independent Cholesky L L^T solver
methods.difference: separate XLSX XML reader and Cholesky L L^T solver with zero shared imports

claims.statement: Pre-registered hypothesis predicting >= 10% held-out log2 MAE reduction over stronger baseline (dmso_ols) with residue-clustered 95% bootstrap CI > 0 is refuted: observed point reduction is +3.7001% (0.016705 log2) and 59-cluster 95% bootstrap CI is [-0.028005, 0.058719].
